{"description":"Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md Section B.2.3

### Core Requirements (§B.2.3 Priority Queuing)

| Priority | Traffic Type | Default Deadline |
|----------|--------------|------------------|
| 0 (high) | Routing control (DIO/DAO) | 5s |
| 1 | Link-layer ACKs | 10s |
| 2 | Urgent app messages | configurable |
| 3 (low) | Bulk data | 60s |

**R1. [MUST]** Support 4 priority levels numbered 0-3 (0=highest, 3=lowest)
**R2. [MUST]** Assign routing control (DIO/DAO) to priority 0
**R3. [MUST]** Assign link-layer ACKs to priority 1
**R4. [MUST]** Assign urgent app messages to priority 2
**R5. [MUST]** Assign bulk data to priority 3
**R6. [MUST]** Higher-priority packets preempt lower-priority when queue is full

### TX Queue Implementation (§B.2 Implementation Guidelines)

**R7. [MUST]** TX queue capacity SHALL be bounded (spec: 4 packets max)
**R8. [MUST]** Check deadline of oldest packet and drop if expired before TX
**R9. [MUST]** If queue full and new packet is higher priority, preempt lowest
**R10. [MUST]** If queue full and same/lower priority, return -ENOBUFS (QueueFullError)
**R11. [MUST]** Track packets_dropped_deadline, packets_dropped_full, max_latency_ms, avg_latency_ms

### Explicit Backpressure (§B.2.4 Explicit Backpressure)

**R12. [MUST]** When queue full, return ENOBUFS/QueueFullError (not silent drop)
**R13. [SHOULD]** Expose queue stats via /status/queues CoAP resource

### Verification

**V1.** Queue-full handling: Sender gets QueueFullError when queue full
**V2.** Deadline expiry: Old packets dropped before transmission
**V3.** Priority preemption: High-priority packets bypass queue
**V4.** No silent drops: All rejections/drops signal the sender

---
NOTE: The spec uses declarative language, not explicit MUST/SHALL keywords.
Requirements above are derived from normative statements in sections B.2.3-B.2.5.
"}
